title: Comparing Two Patterns
short: Build two patterns from rules, pair the terms and graph them.

blocks.html: In Grade 4 you made patterns from a rule, and you can graph pairs of numbers. Now make two patterns side by side and compare them.

Generate both patterns from their rules. Pair up the terms that are in the same position to make ordered pairs. Then look for a relationship: often each term of one pattern is a fixed number of times the matching term of the other.

Pattern A adds 3 each time and pattern B adds 6. After any number of steps, B has added twice as much as A, so each term of B is twice the matching term of A. Graphing the pairs $(3, 6), (6, 12), (9, 18)$ shows the relationship as points on a straight line.

blocks.q: When pattern A reaches 30, what is the matching term of pattern B?

blocks.html: Pairing terms from different positions, such as the 3rd term of A with the 4th term of B, or putting B first in the pair. Check: count both patterns from the same start, and keep the order (term of A, term of B).
